title: Principal Data Engineer Data Technology
description:
**Some careers offer more opportunities than others.**
**If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.**
We are currently seeking a high caliber professional to join our team as
**Principal Data Engineer - Data Technology.**
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an exceptional Principal Engineer to serve as the technical anchor for the Data Technology domain, covering platforms and capabilities including Enterprise Data Assets (EDA), Reference Data, Big Data & Movement, and Data Decisioning engineering.
  
  
This role will drive technical strategy, architecture, and engineering excellence across distributed data platforms that are foundational to data democratization, AI enablement, customer insight, and regulatory compliance. The Principal Engineer will provide hands-on leadership in modern data and digital engineering practices, hybrid cloud enablement, event-driven architecture, and platform scalability to ensure enterprise-ready and future-fit data services.
  
  
This role is suited for a senior technologist with deep experience in data platform engineering and the ability to influence product and delivery teams across a large, global, matrixed organization.
  
  
**In This Role You Will**

* Define and evolve the reference engineering standards for core data provisioning platforms, ensuring alignment to the bank’s Group Data Strategy and Data Future State Architecture.
* Provide deep technical standards and approach leadership across key platforms:-


+ Enterprise Data Assets (EDA) and APIs for standardized data provisioning
+ Reference Data Services for golden source alignment and hierarchy management
+ Big Data and Movement technologies for ingestion, streaming, and transformation at scale
+ Decisioning Infrastructure including real-time feature stores and orchestration

* Lead peer reviews and ensure platform consistency, reusability, and compliance with enterprise standards.
* Guide development teams in implementing data pipelines, APIs, metadata-driven controls, and automated testing frameworks.
* Champion DevSecOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code across engineering teams.
* Drive the control transition to using agentic AI coding assistants.
* Lead the technology Developer Experience, enabling the whole of technology to discover, understand and onboard themselves to our services.
* Drive best practices in observability, performance engineering, cost optimization, and scalability in hybrid cloud environments.
* Mentor senior engineers and influence technical delivery across multiple squads and geographies.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Cybersecurity, CDO, and business product owners to align engineering outcomes to strategic objectives.
* Represent the domain in cross-platform technology councils and architecture forums.

**What You Will Need To Succeed In The Role**

* Relevant & hands-on experience at senior level in data platform engineering, architecture, or software development, preferably in a global financial institution or scaled enterprise.
* Expertise in building large-scale data pipelines, APIs, and event-driven systems using modern frameworks and technologies (e.g., Spring, Kafka, Spark, etc).
* Ability to actively write & deliver code is essential
* Strong architectural understanding of data mesh, data lakehouse, and real-time, customer-facing operational & analytics platforms.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and GCP), containerisation, and IaC tools.
* Deep familiarity with development tooling and automation covering modeling, observability, resilience, and , and governance patterns.
* Strong track record of building reusable platform services that accelerate delivery for data consumers and AI/ML initiatives.
* Experience with enterprise reference data management and integration is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage and guide both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.

**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Cloudesign - Data Engineer - Python
description:

We are looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain robust streaming ETL pipelines.
  
  
Using Python, Confluent, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), you will work with event-driven architecture to develop production-quality data systems.

* Significant experience with relational or NoSQL databases, such as SQL Server, CockroachDB, or PostgreSQL.
* Proven experience designing and building efficient, scalable data pipelines.

* Development and maintenance of a comprehensive data and records governance framework aligned with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
* Monitoring data quality and records metrics and compliance with standards across the organization.
* Identification and addressing of data and records management risks and gaps.
* Development and implementation of a records management programme that ensures the proper identification, classification, storage, retention, retrieval and disposal of records.
* Development and implementation of a data governance strategy that aligns with the bank's overall data management strategy and business objectives.
* Provision of Group wide guidance and training on Data and Records Management standard requirements.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.

description:

**EY GDS | COGNITE DATA ENGINEERING LEAD**
**Oil & Gas | Manager**
**Job Title Cognite Data Engineering Lead – Manager**
**Experience Level 10+ Years**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Data Engineering Lead to implement reliable data pipelines, industrial data models and contextualization workflows in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF). You will own implementation quality, make component-level engineering decisions within the agreed architecture, and deliver data that operational applications and analytical solutions can reliably consume.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Extraction and ingestion**

* Configure supported Cognite extractors and implement API or custom integrations where required.
* Build source-appropriate incremental loads with persistent checkpoints, retries and restart behaviour; handle pagination, throttling, historical backfills and late-arriving updates.
* Implement repeatable writes and reconciliation checks so rerunning failed loads does not create inconsistent results.
* Validate source-to-target counts, time ranges and completeness while preserving identifiers, units and quality information.
* Diagnose failures involving connectivity, permissions, source changes and malformed records.

**Data modelling and transformation**

* Implement approved spaces, containers, views, data models, instances and relationships.
* Reuse or extend Core Data Model concepts in line with the solution design.
* Develop SQL transformations and Python processing for cleansing, normalization, mapping and enrichment.
* Implement stable identifiers and source crosswalks, including collision checks for repeated tags across sites.
* Preserve distinctions between equipment, functional locations and changing assignments; test schema changes and execute migrations without breaking dependent consumers.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas data**

* Implement identifier-based matching, rules and supported contextualization services to connect operational and engineering records.
* Link time series, maintenance activities and documents to the correct equipment or functional location.
* Validate matches against reference mappings, assess coverage and false matches, and route unresolved cases for domain review.
* Maintain mappings when tags, equipment assignments, hierarchies or document revisions change.
* Preserve upstream well and wellbore identities, provenance, tests and intervention history; preserve downstream equipment relationships, units, laboratory timing, and links between diagrams, documents and measurements.

**Testing, deployment and application handoff**

* Write and review production Python and SQL code with automated tests.
* Test completeness, freshness, uniqueness, relationship integrity, time-zone handling and recovery after interruption.
* Maintain configuration in Git and automate supported deployment using Cognite Toolkit.
* Monitor extraction, transformation and workflow execution with actionable logs and failure handling; configure least-privilege access.
* Deliver documented consumer views and example SDK/API queries, verify access and performance, maintain runbooks, and identify design changes requiring architecture review.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Substantial hands-on Cognite Data Fusion implementation experience and understanding of production operation.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, including Cognite SDK and REST API usage.
* Experience implementing CDF data models, transformations and contextualization.
* Experience building pipelines with incremental loading, reconciliation, backfill and recovery.
* Practical knowledge of Git, automated testing, CI/CD and deployment configuration.
* Familiarity with authentication and the CDF capabilities required by integration services.
* Strong implementation knowledge in at least one upstream or downstream setting, with ability to apply relevant concepts to the other.
* Evidence of personally delivering and troubleshooting data pipelines used by operational or engineering applications.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Cognite Toolkit, extraction pipeline monitoring and workflow orchestration.
* Familiarity with AVEVA PI, SAP maintenance data, IBM Maximo, laboratory systems or well-data services.
* Experience with WITSML, OPC UA, database extraction or enterprise APIs.
* Experience with document or diagram contextualization and 3D associations.
* Working knowledge of a major cloud platform and containerized integration services.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A technical lead who can demonstrate a functioning ingestion-to-consumption workflow, explain their personal implementation contribution, and show how failed loads, duplicate records, incorrect relationships and application-access issues are detected and corrected.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: TDM Engineer - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**

If we use it for the things that really matter, it can improve people's lives and the world around us. Through our technology we empower people, connecting everyone regardless of who they are or where they live and we protect the planet, whilst helping our customers do the same.

If you require any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request as part of your recruitment journey, for example, extended time or breaks in between online assessments, please refer to https://careers.vodafone.com/application-adjustments/ for guidance.
  
  
Together we can.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Manage demand intake and feasibility, working with project, testing and application teams to clarify scope, data conditions, environments, timelines, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
  
  
Perform data analysis and discovery, analysing schemas, relationships, business rules and data patterns to translate functional scenarios into precise test-data selection or creation logic.
  
  
Deliver test-data provisioning by extracting, subsetting, refreshing, cloning, masking or generating data using approved TDM platforms and scripts while preserving referential integrity and usability.
  
  
Develop automation and reusable capabilities, including repeatable workflows, utilities, templates and self-service solutions that reduce manual effort and improve turnaround times.
  
  
Manage requests through agreed ticketing processes, maintaining appropriate evidence, status updates, blockers and closure information while meeting service levels.
  
  
Write and optimise SQL for data analysis, extraction, transformation, validation and reconciliation.
  
  
Coordinate with DBAs, environment teams, application owners, security teams and testers to resolve dependencies.
  
  
Support incident analysis and root-cause investigation for data defects, failed jobs and environment issues.
  
  
Contribute to Agile delivery through sprint execution, backlog refinement and collaboration within Scrum, Kanban or SAFe environments.
  
  
Support API integration and partner onboarding and testing activities, including reusable integration documentation, data mappings and technical artefacts.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You have a degree or higher degree in software engineering or a related technical discipline.
  
  
You have strong SQL and relational database knowledge, including joins, procedures, constraints, query tuning, data validation, relational models, keys and dependencies.
  
  
You have experience with relational database technologies such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, DB2, MySQL or equivalent.
  
  
You have practical TDM engineering knowledge covering data discovery, subsetting, masking, synthetic data generation, refresh, cloning and referential integrity.
  
  
You have experience with K2View, Informatica TDM, Delphix, Broadcom TDM or equivalent TDM technology.
  
  
You have scripting and workflow automation experience using technologies such as Python, Shell, PowerShell, REST APIs and CI/CD tooling.
  
  
You are familiar with delivery and service-management tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence, Git and reporting dashboards.
  
  
You have practical experience working within Scrum, Kanban or SAFe environments and can manage sprint activities and contribute to backlog refinement.
  
  
You bring effective communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, attention to detail and a collaborative approach to delivery.
  
  
Experience with API integration and testing, including ownership across the integration lifecycle, is preferred.
  
  
Previous experience within the telecommunications industry and SAFe Agile/Scrum environments is preferred.
  
  
Knowledge of AWS cloud infrastructure, automation framework design and scripting languages such as Python or Go is beneficial.
  
  
**Not a perfect fit?**
Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* Take end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents and contribute directly to protecting customers, services, data and operations
* Work collaboratively with specialist teams including CSOC, Threat Intelligence, Forensics/CERT, IT and Network teams
* Gain exposure to complex cybersecurity incidents across multiple intake channels and production environments
* Develop experience in risk-based decision-making, stakeholder communication and incident coordination

**What Skills You Will Learn**
Through the scope of this role, you can further develop:
  
  
Advanced cybersecurity incident triage, investigation and prioritisation.
  
  
Alert, log and IoC correlation across security environments.
  
  
Risk and business-impact assessment.
  
  
Incident escalation and cross-functional response coordination.
  
  
Audit-ready cybersecurity incident documentation.
  
  
Stakeholder communication during complex and high-priority incidents.
  
  
End-to-end incident lifecycle and SLA management.
  
  
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitmentn**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.

description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
  
  
**Job Details**
Cencora is a leading global pharmaceutical distribution and healthcare solutions organization dedicated to improving the lives of people and animals worldwide. Through its extensive network of manufacturers, healthcare providers, pharmacies, and patients, Cencora helps ensure timely and reliable access to critical therapies and healthcare services. The company continually invests in innovative technologies, operational excellence, and talented professionals to advance healthcare delivery and create meaningful impact across the global healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
**Summary**
The Senior Platform Engineer for Leena AI is a senior individual contributor within the Platform Engineering organization, responsible for owning and operating Cencora's Leena AI deployment — an agentic AI platform used to automate HR, IT, and employee support workflows at enterprise scale. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role applies deep technical expertise to extend Leena AI's capabilities by connecting it to internal systems via custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, alongside platform configuration, integration engineering, and operational monitoring responsibilities.
  
  
Platform Administration
  
  

* Configure and maintain the Leena AI instance, including Knowledge Studio content sources, permissions and access controls, and governance policies.

title: Senior ETL Test Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**
Business Title -
**Lead QA (ETL Tester)**
Years of Experience - Min 6 and max up to 9 Years
  
  
**Job Description**
The purpose of this role is to ensure the developed software meets the client requirements and the business’ quality standards within the project release cycle and established processes. To lead QA technical initiatives in order to optimize the test approach and tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and execute DWH, Database, ETL, and Data Validation testing across end-to-end data pipelines.
* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, test conditions, and test data.
* Prepare detailed test plans, test strategies, test estimates, test procedures, and expected results.
* Develop and execute complex SQL queries to validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, transformation logic, and reconciliation.
* Perform source-to-target data validation and verify data mappings, transformations, aggregations, joins, and business rules.
* Design and execute positive, negative, boundary, exception, and data-volume test scenarios to ensure complete test coverage.
* Perform ETL testing by validating data extraction, transformation, loading, error handling, and data integrity.
* Conduct functional, integration, system, regression, data quality, performance/load, and UAT testing as required.
* Validate data across multiple databases, data sources, staging areas, DWH layers, and reporting/analytics systems.
* Investigate data mismatches and failures using SQL and other debugging techniques, identify root causes, and document findings clearly.
* Log, prioritize, track, and manage defects through JIRA and ensure timely closure with development and technical teams.
* Perform defect retesting and regression testing after fixes and ensure issues are validated across all applicable test cycles.
* Identify data quality issues and process failures and recommend appropriate remediation strategies.
* Work closely with Business Analysts, Developers, Data Engineers, Product Owners, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve testing issues.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, refinement, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Provide regular updates on testing progress, defect status, risks, dependencies, test coverage, and release readiness to project stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of QA standards, testing frameworks, best practices, and reusable test assets.
* Identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency through automation, reusable SQL scripts, test data management, and process improvements.
* Support testing activities across medium- to large-scale projects and multiple releases.
* Mentor and guide 2–3 QA Associates, review their work, and support their technical development.
* Take ownership of assigned testing deliverables and ensure they are completed within agreed timelines and quality standards.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in DWH Testing and Database Testing.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex queries, joins, subqueries, CTEs, aggregations, and data reconciliation.
* Hands-on experience in ETL Testing and understanding of ETL/data pipeline processes.
* Strong understanding of Data Warehousing concepts, including fact tables, dimension tables, star/snowflake schemas, staging, data marts, and data transformations.
* Experience with source-to-target validation and data reconciliation.
* Ability to analyze data discrepancies, debug issues, identify root causes, and document defects effectively.
* Strong ability to understand business/technical requirements and convert them into end-to-end test scenarios and test cases.
* Experience in functional, regression, integration, system, data quality, performance/load, and UAT testing.
* Hands-on experience with at least one ETL tool.
* Experience working with Azure Cloud, preferably Azure Data services.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Hands-on experience with JIRA or similar defect/test management tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) or other Azure Data services.
* Experience with Snowflake or other cloud-based data warehouses.
* Experience testing REST/SOAP APIs.
* Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or similar tools.
* Experience with data quality and data profiling tools.
* Exposure to automation testing or scripting.
* Experience working with reporting/BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Experience in performance/load testing of data pipelines or databases.
* Strong stakeholder management and client communication experience.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent relevant industry experience may also be considered.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Azure certifications, preferably Azure Data Engineer Associate.
* Snowflake Associate / SnowPro Core certification.
* Relevant QA/testing certifications such as ISTQB are an added advantage.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Hands-on Senior QA / DWH Testing professional with strong SQL and ETL testing expertise.
* Strong understanding of data validation, reconciliation, data quality, and data warehousing concepts.
* Comfortable working independently on complex testing assignments and taking ownership of QA deliverables.
* Able to communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and clients.
* Demonstrated experience in mentoring junior QA team members.
* Exposure to Azure and/or Snowflake is highly desirable.

title: Team Lead, ADM Ops
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
Addepar's Private Fund Look-Through (PFLT) offering gives clients deep visibility into the underlying holdings of their private fund investments by extracting holding-level data directly from GP financial statements—primarily the Schedule of Investments (SOI). This white-glove solution combines proprietary AI/ML extraction technology with human-in-the-loop review to ensure maximum accuracy and full portfolio transparency.
  
  
As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the
**PFLT Data Operations Team Lead**
is responsible for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts focused on reviewing, validating, and enriching complex fund holding data within target SLAs. This role acts as a domain subject matter expert, overseeing exception resolution, pipeline monitoring (Databricks, Retool, Monday.com), and data entity mapping. You will play a pivotal role in driving team performance metrics, leading ML model retraining initiatives, and collaborating across Product, Engineering, ML Operations, and Client Success teams.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage a team of PFLT Analysts & Senior Analysts, driving effective work allocation, daily queue management (Monday.com), and SLA compliance across peak quarter-end processing periods.
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Support operational workflows, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for private fund Look-through processing.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation across the pipeline.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting the team on complex Schedule of Investments (SOI) processing, special asset classes (e.g., crypto/token assets, real estate), and intricate fund accounting mechanics (e.g., PQ reconciliation, derived metric calculations, corporate actions).
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex extraction errors across pipeline stages and front-end verification checks.
* Perform quality control reviews and high-level audits to assist the team in correcting improperly extracted or mapped holdings data.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for data quality discrepancies, pipeline failures, and complex mapping issues (SOAP UI, GSM Search, PitchBook).
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and AIP teams to enhance operational efficiency by identifying extraction errors, curating edge-case datasets for AI model retraining, and refining pipeline tooling and UI (Retool/Databricks).
* Engage directly with clients, GPs, and Fund Administrators to resolve technical data inquiries, document discrepancies, and reporting edge cases.

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
* Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

**About the role:**

Quantum Integrators is hiring a Senior AI Architect to design and deliver production AI systems for our enterprise clients. You will own the technical vision for generative AI, agentic and machine learning solutions, from first discovery workshop through to scaled deployment.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role. You will shape architecture, guide engineering teams, and help clients turn AI pilots into secure, governed systems that deliver measurable business value.

**What you'll do,**

* Lead the end-to-end architecture of AI solutions: LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and classical ML models.
* Partner with client executives and stakeholders to identify high-value use cases, assess feasibility, and define roadmaps.
* Select and integrate models, frameworks and platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, open-source models) based on cost, performance and risk.
* Design scalable data and integration patterns that connect AI services to enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM and data platforms.
* Define MLOps and LLMOps practices covering evaluation, monitoring, versioning, CI/CD and cost control.
* Build in security, privacy and responsible AI controls, including guardrails, access management and compliance with regulations such as the EU AI Act.
* Guide and mentor engineers and data scientists; review designs and code, and set reference architectures and standards.
* Build proofs of concept quickly, then harden them for production.
* Support pre-sales: scope solutions, write technical proposals and present to client leadership.
* Track emerging AI research and tools, and turn what matters into reusable accelerators for the practice.

**What you bring:**

* 10+ years in software engineering, data engineering or solution architecture, with 3+ years architecting AI/ML solutions in production.
* Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications: prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, fine-tuning and agent frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Deep expertise in at least one major cloud (Azure, AWS or GCP) and its AI services.

title: Cloud Data Engineer
description:
Step into the role of Cloud Data Engineer at Barclays, where you'll help shape and deliver our cloud-first data strategy. This role will design and build scalable AWS data platforms, analytics capabilities, and reusable data products. You will work in a collaborative engineering team to move trusted data from golden-source systems into governed cloud data layers and make it available for analytics and downstream consumption.
  
  
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:
  
  
  

* Contribute to the cloud data strategy and translate business and analytical requirements into secure, scalable AWS data solutions.
* Design, build, test, deploy, and support batch and event-driven data pipelines using AWS services such as AWS Glue, Step Functions, Lambda, Athena, S3, and EC2.
* Use enterprise hydration frameworks to ingest data from golden-source systems into governed source-aligned layers in the cloud.
* Develop curated data models and reusable data products that are discoverable, trusted, and suitable for analytics, reporting, and downstream applications.
* Design and implement data lake and data warehouse patterns, including appropriate partitioning, file formats, metadata, and performance optimization.
* Develop robust transformation logic using SQL and Python or PySpark, with appropriate testing, reconciliation, and error handling.
* Implement workflow orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, alerting, restart, and recovery capabilities for production data pipelines.
* Apply data quality, lineage, metadata, security, access-control, retention, and audit requirements throughout the data lifecycle.
* Optimize cloud data workloads for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost.
* Collaborate with data architects, platform engineers, source-system teams, analysts, product owners, and governance stakeholders.
* Follow engineering standards for source control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and operational support.
* Investigate production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes and preventative controls.

**Essential Skills / Qualifications**

* Relevant data engineering experience, including the design and delivery of production-grade data pipelines and analytical data platforms.
* Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, data lake concepts, ETL/ELT patterns, and data lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience building cloud data solutions on AWS using AWS Glue, Step Functions, Lambda, Athena, S3, and EC2.
* Proficiency in Python and/or PySpark for data processing, automation, and integration.
* Experience ingesting data from relational databases, files, APIs, and other enterprise sources into governed cloud data layers.
* Experience working with reusable ingestion or hydration frameworks and configurable, metadata-driven pipeline patterns.
* Ability to build curated data products from source-aligned data, including transformation, validation, reconciliation, and publication for consumers.
* Knowledge of data quality, metadata, lineage, security, encryption, identity and access management, monitoring, and audit controls.
* Experience with Git-based source control, automated testing, CI/CD, and deployment across development, test, and production environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, stakeholder-management, and written and verbal communication skills.

**Desirable / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with Databricks, including Apache Spark, Delta Lake, notebooks, workflows, and Unity Catalog.
* Experience with Astronomer or Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration and operational monitoring.
* Knowledge of AWS services such as Redshift, EMR, Lake Formation, Kinesis, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, IAM, and CloudFormation.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Familiarity with data mesh or data-product principles, including ownership, discoverability, interoperability, and service-level expectations.
* Experience with data observability, schema evolution, data contracts, and cloud cost optimization.
* Relevant AWS or Databricks certification.
* Experience in banking or financial services and working within enterprise risk, security, and compliance frameworks.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To build and maintain the systems that collect, store, process, and analyse data, such as data pipelines, data warehouses and data lakes to ensure that all data is accurate, accessible, and secure.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Build and maintenance of data architectures pipelines that enable the transfer and processing of durable, complete and consistent data.
* Design and implementation of data warehoused and data lakes that manage the appropriate data volumes and velocity and adhere to the required security measures.
* Development of processing and analysis algorithms fit for the intended data complexity and volumes.
* Collaboration with data scientist to build and deploy machine learning models.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. description:
**Job Summary**
Leads projects for design, development and maintenance of a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with key business stakeholders, IT experts and subject-matter experts to plan, design and deliver optimal analytics and data science solutions. Works on one or many product teams at a time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Designs and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event-based, unstructured). Designs and implements framework to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Designs and provide guidance on building reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Designs and implements physical data models to define the database structure. Optimizing database performance through efficient indexing and table relationships. Participates in optimizing, testing, and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Designs, develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses innovative and modern tools, techniques and architectures to partially or completely automate the most-common, repeatable and tedious data preparation and integration tasks in order to minimize manual and error-prone processes and improve productivity. Assists with renovating the data management infrastructure to drive automation in data integration and management. Ensures the timeliness and success of critical analytics initiatives by using agile development technologies such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban Coaches and develops less experienced team members.
  
  
**Competencies**
System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Data Extraction - Performs data extract-transform-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.
  
  
Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Quality Assurance Metrics - Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.
  
  
Solution Documentation - Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
  
  
Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
  
  
Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
  
  
Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Intermediate experience in a relevant discipline area is required. Knowledge of the latest technologies and trends in data engineering are highly preferred and includes:
  
  

* Familiarity analyzing complex business systems, industry requirements, and/or data regulations
* Background in processing and managing large data sets
* Design and development for a Big Data platform using open source and third-party tools
* SPARK, Scala/Java, Map-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
* SQL query language
* Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
* Experience developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud-based environment and other data extraction tools and methods from a variety of sources
* Experience in building analytical solutions

**Intermediate Experiences In The Following Are Preferred**

* Experience with IoT technology
* Experience in Agile software development

Core Responsibilities Unique to the Role
  
  

* Lead the design, governance, and continuous evolution of enterprise data models and data products, including conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling. We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Senior Big Data Engineer (7+ Years) to join our technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing high-performance, large-scale data processing pipelines and regulatory data platforms using Apache Spark, Java/Scala, Spring Boot, and Python/PySpark.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in distributed data computing, complex Spark SQL query optimization, data analysis, and modern CI/CD DevOps workflows. You will actively leverage GenAI engineering tools (such as GitHub Copilot and Devin AI) to accelerate delivery, drive code quality, and translate complex business requirements into robust High-Level (HLD) and Low-Level Designs (LLD).

End-to-End System Design: Analyze business and regulatory requirements to create comprehensive High-Level Designs (HLD), Low-Level Designs (LLD), data flow diagrams, and interface specifications.
  
  
Data Engineering & Analytics: Perform in-depth data analysis across the data lifecycle—including data sourcing, schema evolution, transformation logic, quality validation, and actionable insight generation.
  
  
Spark SQL Optimization: Write, tune, and maintain complex Spark SQL queries, partitioned datasets, and transformations for optimal performance over large enterprise datasets.
  
  
Microservices & API Integration: Build enterprise-grade services and data ingestion microservices using Spring and Spring Boot.
  
  
DevOps & CI/CD Delivery: Implement automated build, test, and deployment workflows using Git/GitHub, Jenkins / Lightspeed, and Harness.
  
  
AI-Augmented Engineering: Leverage modern GenAI developer tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Devin AI) to accelerate prototyping, code review, unit testing, and documentation.
  
  
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Owners, Data Analysts, Business Teams, and Quality Assurance to ensure end-to-end alignment and timely delivery.
  
  
**Candidate Qualifications & Skill Set**

* Core Technical Skills (Must-Have)

Experience:5-9 years of hands-on software and data engineering experience in enterprise environments.
  
  
Distributed Computing & Big Data: Deep practical expertise in Apache Spark architecture (RDDs, DataFrames, Datasets, execution plans, memory management, partitioning, and performance tuning).
  
  
Primary Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in Java and/or Scala, with strong object-oriented and functional programming paradigms.
  
  
Frameworks: Extensive hands-on experience building scalable applications using Java and Apache Spark.
  
  
Scripting & Python/PySpark: Strong proficiency in Python with practical experience writing data transformations using PySpark.
  
  
Data Querying & SQL: Expert-level proficiency in SQL / Spark SQL, window functions, complex joins, indexing, and query plan execution analysis (EXPLAIN).
  
  
Data Analysis & Processing: Proven ability to source, cleanse, enrich, reconcile, and validate large datasets to deliver high-integrity reporting and analytical outputs.
  
  

* Architecture & DevOps

Solution Architecture: Proven track record of drafting clear, maintainable HLD and LLD documents, technical specifications, and data modeling artifacts.
  
  
Version Control & CI/CD: Hands-on experience with GitHub / Bitbucket, build automation with Jenkins / Lightspeed, and modern continuous delivery platforms like Harness.
  
  

* AI Tools & Modern Engineering Practices

AI-Assisted Development: Experience utilizing AI productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot or Devin AI for test generation, code refactoring, and rapid prototyping.
  
  
Engineering Excellence: Strong commitment to test-driven development (TDD), automated unit/integration testing, SonarQube quality gates, and secure coding standards.
  
  

* Preferred / Good-to-Have

Business Intelligence & Visualization: Experience with Tableau or similar BI visualization tools for dashboarding and reporting validation.
  
  
Domain Knowledge: Prior exposure to Banking, Financial Services, Liquidity Reporting, Regulatory Data (e.g., NDTL/LCR), or Risk Management.
  
  

* Soft Skills & Professional Attributes

Exceptional Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills; adept at explaining technical concepts to both technical peers and non-technical business stakeholders.
  
  
Ownership & Problem Solving: Proactive attitude, strong analytical reasoning, and the ability to drive initiatives from inception to production deployment.

title: Sr Lead, Database Development
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  

* Primary DBA Ownership (Core Accountability)
* Act as the primary DBA for all Data Protection databases across production, UAT, and development environments.
* Own database availability, performance, capacity, security, backup, recovery, and lifecycle management.
* Serve as final technical escalation for database incidents, outages, and data integrity issues.
* Define and enforce DBA standards, operational guardrails, and support models.
* Database Architecture & Engineering
* Design, build, and maintain enterprise grade SQL Server databases (on premise and cloud, including Azure SQL Managed Instance).
* Own physical and logical database design, including:
* Schema design
* Indexing strategies
* Partitioning
* Performance tuning
* Lead database strategy for new Data Protection services, integrations, and platform migrations.
* Govern schema evolution to ensure backward compatibility and reporting stability.
* Performance, Reliability & Capacity Management
* Proactively monitor and tune database performance (queries, indexes, memory, IO).
* Lead capacity planning and forecasting, including storage, compute, and growth modelling.
* Design and test backup, restore, disaster recovery, and high availability strategies in line with enterprise RTO/RPO expectations.
* Data Ingestion, ETL & Automation
* Provide senior DBA oversight and hands on support for ETL and ingestion pipelines.
* Ensure ingestion processes are performant, resilient, recoverable, and auditable.
* Optimize ingestion for high volume, complex, and inconsistent datasets.
* Drive automation to reduce manual DBA intervention and operational risk.
* SQL Engineering & Reporting Enablement
* Develop and govern complex SQL queries, views, and stored procedures that underpin:
* Regulatory reporting
* Audit evidence
* Executive dashboards
* Ensure reporting accuracy, data lineage, and traceability.
* Act as escalation point for reporting failures driven by database issues.
* Security, Controls & Regulatory Readiness
* Own database level security controls, including:
* Access control models
* Service account governance
* Credential rotation
* Encryption and secure connectivity
* Ensure databases meet audit, regulatory, and risk management expectations, including evidence production.
* Partner with Risk, Audit, and Control teams to remediate database related findings.
* Operational Leadership
* Lead response to major incidents and post incident root cause analysis.
* Mentor engineers and analysts on database best practices without direct line management.
* Provide clear risk signals, options, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Represent DBA interests in architecture, change, and governance forums.
* Documentation & Standards
* Own DBA runbooks, operational documentation, health check reporting, and capacity plans.
* Define repeatable operational procedures for database changes and maintenance.
* Contribute to Data Protection service documentation and control narratives.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

* Proven track record executing enterprise data strategies and roadmaps to accelerate modernization, improve business outcomes, and strengthen organizational agility

title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
Driven by transformative digital technologies and trends, we are RIB and we’ve made it our purpose to propel the industry forward and make engineering and construction more efficient and sustainable. Built on deep industry expertise and best practice, and with our people at the heart of everything we do, we deliver the world's leading end-to-end lifecycle solutions that empower our industry to build better.

With a steadfast commitment to innovation and a keen eye on the future, RIB comprises over 2,500 talented individuals who extend our software’s reach to over 100 countries worldwide. We are experienced experts and professionals from different cultures and backgrounds and we collaborate closely to provide transformative software products, innovative thinking and professional services to our global market. Our strong teams across the globe enable sustainable product investment and enhancements, to keep our clients at the cutting-edge of engineering, infrastructure and construction technology.

We know our people are our success – join us to be part of a global force that uses innovation to enhance the way the world builds.

Find out more at RIB Careers.

**Job Title: Azure Data Engineer**

**Location: Nashik/Pune, India**

**Experience Required: 5 to 8 Years**

**Employment Type: Fulltime**

**The job**

As an Azure Data Engineer, you will be part of a growing data engineering team building scalable and secure data platforms for SaaS, multi-tenant applications. You will work closely with senior engineers to develop data pipelines, perform transformations, and support event-driven data workflows while continuously learning modern Azure data technologies. Our engineering workflow is AI-augmented — you will work alongside Agentic AI tools as part of daily development, so comfort with AI-assisted engineering is a core part of this role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain data pipelines using Azure Synapse and Spark notebooks
* Perform data ingestion, transformation, and incremental loading from multiple sources
* Support background processing and automation using Azure Functions
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases to model and manage data
* Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline issues and performance bottlenecks
* Use AI coding assistants and Agentic AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate development, testing, and documentation, while critically reviewing and validating AI-generated output

**Essential Requirements**

* Experience with Azure Synapse Analytics (Pipelines, SQL pools)
* Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, or Cosmos DB
* Good SQL skills and basic data modelling knowledge
* Understanding of incremental loads, CDC, and performance tuning
* Basic knowledge of Azure security (Managed Identity, RBAC, Key Vault)
* AI proficiency: hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) in day-to-day engineering work — including effective prompting, and the judgment to verify AI-generated code and SQL before it ships

**Desired Skills**

* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric or Delta Lake / Parquet formats
* Basic understanding of event-driven or asynchronous processing
* Familiarity with CI/CD, Git, and collaborative development practices
* Strong logical thinking and willingness to learn
* Exposure to Agentic AI workflows — AI agents that plan and execute multi-step engineering tasks — or agent frameworks (e.g., Claude Code / Agent SDK, Microsoft agent frameworks)
* Familiarity with Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry) or building LLM-backed features such as RAG over data platforms

RIB may require all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

RIB is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.

Come and join RIB to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to build a better world.

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**
Avantor is looking for a dynamic, forward-thinking, and experienced
**Senior Data Engineer**
, delivering results against some of the most complex business and technology initiatives.
  
  
This role will be a full-time position based out of our Pune or Coimbatore office.
  
  
If you are passionate about solving complex challenges and driving innovation – let's talk!
  
  
Our organization is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
  
  
The Senior Data Engineer drives data-driven strategies and delivers impactful insights to optimize data platforms, analytics enablement, and business decision-making. This role requires strong engineering depth across modern ELT tooling, analytical expertise, strategic thinking, and the ability to mentor and lead within a cross-functional team.
  
  
**Job Description**
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:
  
  
**Certifications**
Preferred SnowPro Core and/or SnowPro Advanced certifications. dbt Certification (Analytics Engineer) is a plus.
  
  
**Experience**

* 10–12 years of overall experience in IT, with a strong focus on data engineering and cloud data platforms.
* 6+ years of architecture or engineering experience in data modeling, building data pipelines, ELT/ETL frameworks, data products, and distributed data systems.
* 6+ years of experience within Data Warehousing: management (star schemas, snowflake schemas, dimensional modeling) within Snowflake.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with dbt (data build tool) — building and maintaining modular transformation layers, testing frameworks, macros, and documentation (dbt docs/lineage).
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Fivetran (or similar managed ELT/connector tools) for automated data ingestion from SaaS, ERP, and database sources.
* 3+ years of experience enabling or supporting BI/reporting layers using Power BI — including semantic modeling, DAX, and performance optimization of datasets feeding dashboards.
* Exposure to or working knowledge of Generative AI concepts and tools (LLM-based data documentation/cataloging, natural-language-to-SQL tools, AI-assisted data quality or anomaly detection, Copilot-style dev tooling) — hands-on production experience is a plus, not mandatory.

**Nice To Have**

* 5+ years of experience with Python for data engineering (scripting, automation, orchestration).
* Experience with PySpark for large-scale data processing.
* Experience processing semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet, Avro).
* Exposure to orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, or Snowflake Tasks/Streams).
* Familiarity with using LLMs/GenAI APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock) to accelerate data engineering workflows — e.g., auto-generating dbt documentation, AI-assisted SQL/data quality checks, or building lightweight natural-language query interfaces over Snowflake.

**Those Necessary To Perform The Job Competently**

* Thorough knowledge of Snowflake architecture (virtual warehouses, micro-partitioning, clustering, cost/performance optimization).
* Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining dbt projects — models, tests, snapshots, incremental strategies, and CI/CD integration for dbt deployments.
* Strong hands-on experience configuring and managing Fivetran connectors, sync schedules, transformations, and troubleshooting ingestion failures.
* Expertise in designing data models (dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas) for both operational reporting and self-service analytics.
* Should have worked on preparation of Technical Specification documents and data pipeline design documentation.
* Working knowledge of SAP systems as a source system (SAP ECC/S4HANA extraction patterns), integrated via Fivetran or custom pipelines into Snowflake.
* Experience enabling Power BI consumption layers — building/optimizing Snowflake views or dbt marts specifically for BI performance.
* Very good analytical skills to independently analyze and resolve ELT, SQL, and pipeline issues.
* Ability to provide effort estimation for data engineering initiatives.
* Ability to engage directly with business stakeholders, gather requirements, and work independently to translate them into scalable pipeline/data model designs.
* Advanced knowledge of data warehousing concepts and schema design trade-offs.
* Curiosity and practical interest in applying GenAI/LLM capabilities to modernize data engineering workflows (e.g., automated documentation, natural-language interfaces, intelligent data quality monitoring).
* SAP functional knowledge is good to have.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Computer Science or other equivalent majors).
  
  
**How You Will Thrive And Create An Impact**

* Collaborate with the Analytics and BI teams to prototype and prove the viability of new data solutions, including GenAI-assisted approaches where applicable.
* Own the end-to-end data pipeline lifecycle: ingestion (Fivetran) → transformation (dbt) → storage/modeling (Snowflake) → consumption (Power BI).
* Lead development and execution of data engineering initiatives across specific projects, mentoring junior engineers on best practices.
* Be hands-on in Snowflake development, dbt model design, and Fivetran pipeline configuration/administration.
* Explore and pilot GenAI use cases that improve data engineering productivity — e.g., AI-assisted documentation, automated test generation, or natural-language querying over the Snowflake warehouse.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating cross-functionally with product owners, business stakeholders, and management.
* Provide technical leadership in the development of engineering standards (dbt style guides, naming conventions, testing coverage expectations).
* Comfortable with rapid prototyping and disciplined software development practices (version control, CI/CD, code review for dbt/SQL).
* Perform other duties as assigned.

They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Data Engineer
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to join our team in . This is a senior individual-contributor and technical leadership role that drives design standards and guides a team's engineering practices. It will appeal to you if you combine deep technical mastery with the ability to lead the technical direction of a team and elevate its overall engineering quality.
  
  
You will set the technical bar for how we build and operate data platforms at scale, balancing hands-on architecture with team leadership. Our teams are small, agile, and focused on the needs of the high growth fintech marketplace, and you will work across functional teams within Mastercard to deliver on our cloud strategy.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Set and enforce design standards, patterns, and best practices for pipelines built on Databricks, Spark, Python, PySpark, and dbt.
  
  
Provide technical leadership and direction to a team of engineers, owning architecture and design reviews.
  
  
Lead the design of CI/CD (GitLab, Jenkins), DataOps, and data observability strategy for the team.
  
  
Own Databricks platform administration standards and deployment governance using Databricks Asset Bundles.
  
  
Drive resolution of complex technical challenges across pipelines and the platform.
  
  
Mentor and grow engineers, establishing a strong code review and quality culture.
  
  
Partner with product and stakeholders on roadmap, prioritization, and technical trade-offs.
  
  
Own the deployment, migration, and upgrade strategy for the team's data platforms.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or a related technical field.
  
  
8+ years of data engineering experience, including demonstrated technical leadership.
  
  
Expert hands-on experience with Databricks (including administration), Spark, Python, and PySpark.
  
  
Deep dbt/TDD and CI/CD (GitLab, Jenkins) expertise.
  
  
Proven ability to define engineering standards and lead a team's practices.
  
  
Strong architecture and platform ownership across observability, cost, and performance.
  
  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Ideally you have experience in banking, e-commerce, credit cards or payment processing and exposure to both SaaS and premises-based architectures. In addition, you have a post-secondary degree in computer science, mathematics, or quantitative science.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
